name: modules/device
description: The platform itself: permissions and notifications.

floors.mutation-is-zero-because: Eight adapters over the bridge and one word table. Each adapter is held by its port's contract — Scanning, DeviceAuth, Networking, Sharing, Capture, Notifier, Clock and Entropy — which runs the shipped adapter and its fake over one set of assertions. What a mutant would land in beyond that is the call itself, and a bridge call is measured against a scripted answer rather than against a device.
